title: Writing a report now crashes when shadow adjudications are present due to tuple unpack mismatch

finding.claim: Writing a report now crashes when shadow adjudications are present due to tuple unpack mismatch
finding.recommendation: Make the producer and consumer agree on the tuple shape from _shadow_evidence_targets, or unpack with the correct arity in both _iter_evidence_refs and _attach_evidence_sidecars. Add a test that writes a report containing shadow_adjudications.

refutation.reason: The finding claims a tuple unpack mismatch, but the code at line 5788 unpacks exactly three variables (container, key, cap) from _shadow_evidence_targets(). The evidence_quote from the finding matches the code exactly, confirming the unpack is correct and the claim is false.

probe.summary: Shadow-tuple probe (`probes/closingA_shadow_tuple.py`): `_shadow_evidence_targets` over a fully populated shadow entry yields 8 tuples, ALL of arity 3 (container, key, cap) — the unpack the claim says mismatches. The real write path was then executed: write_report on a report carrying the entry SUCCEEDED (JSON + markdown written), the entry's sidecars attached (8 files, 8 refs), `_validate_evidence_sidecars` returned no problems, and `_iter_evidence_refs` walked 8 refs. The claimed crash does not occur at HEAD (the merge that reshuffled this region kept the 3-tuple contract; a suite pin for this path was added in this workup under 5683aa292958).
